body:
This is needed for testing a scheduling cycle, refactoring the tests needs more attention as it uses concurrency that isn't easy to reason about.
Also I remember why I made this part of the interface, some of the users have custom processing of events (this avoids for them write a tool that integrates with etcd + whatever custom logic).
I added a note to say that event should be copied before processing

body:
I actually believe, that we should set "related" to preemptor
[it's exactly the example of case for which related was created].

I actually think it's possible to get rid of id from the interface, but I don't want to block this PR before code freeze.

Can you please add a TODO to figure out if it can be removed?
s/id/it/
This shouldn't be part of this interface - this case easily be a helper function in utils.go or sth like that.

Please move all the changes to events implementation to a separate PR (also see my comment below).

This one should touch only scheduler code and tests related to it.

I'd leave it here for now to merge this PR. 

I can send then a PR to refactor the testing, as it relies on events being emitted.

It's negligible refactor - unless I'm not missing something, the only thing you need is to pass a watch.Interface to this method and change the 3 calls to that function to pass e.Watch() - seems like 10 lines of code.
Instead, can you create "newEventsRuls()" (or sth like that, better name welcome) and use it here?
Once this PR will pass tests, friendly ping for this comment.
leaderElectionBroadcaster
I don't see cc.LeaderElectionBroadcaster to be set anywhere in the code - seems like a bug to me.
